leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply validation middleware to an Express route to enforce input constraints.
Configure a schema-based validator to check request body data types and required fields.
Implement custom validation logic to handle specific business rules for user input.
Integrate sanitization functions to clean and normalize incoming data before processing.
Construct error handling middleware to return structured validation failure responses.
Manipulate request objects by stripping or escaping unsafe characters from user-provided strings.
Initialize and use a validation library to protect against common injection attacks in form submissions.
